message.text: Let me look at the repository structure to get oriented.
This appears to be the memos project (usememos/memos), so I should check the internal scheduler and server runner directories.
Let me look at the server code to find where these runners get started.Ripgrep isn't working, so let me switch to using regular shell grep instead.

The scheduler package doesn't seem referenced anywhere outside its own tests, so I want to confirm that across the whole repo. I also need to check whether the memopayload runner's loop is actually started as a background worker in server.go, or if only the direct rebuild function is called synchronously.

I confirm only the s3presign runner runs as a background process, ticking every 12 hours plus firing once immediately on startup. The memopayload Runner exists but is never started as a background loop -- its RebuildMemoPayload function is instead called synchronously inside memo_service.go's create/update handlers. And the internal/scheduler package doesn't appear to be referenced anywhere else in the codebase.

Both confirm: `internal/scheduler` is never imported outside its own package, and `memopayload.NewRunner`/`memopayload.Runner` is never instantiated anywhere (only the standalone `RebuildMemoPayload` function is used, called synchronously from request handlers).

Let me check `cmd/memos` too, in case runners are wired there instead of `server.go`.

Nothing there either. This confirms `server/server.go` is the sole place background runners get started.

q28.
- **s3presign runner** (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`) — started in `startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:161-171`): runs once immediately via `RunOnce(ctx)` at server startup, then loops forever driven by a `time.NewTicker(12 * time.Hour)` inside `Runner.Run` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41`), re-checking/presigning S3 attachment URLs every 12 hours until the server shuts down (context cancellation).

Unused scheduling infrastructure:
- **`internal/scheduler` package** (cron-style scheduler with cron expression parsing, timezone support, middleware, etc. — `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `parser.go`, `middleware.go`, `job.go`) is fully implemented but never imported or used anywhere outside its own package/tests (confirmed via repo-wide search) — the server does not use it to drive any job.
- **`server/runner/memopayload.Runner`** (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`) defines a `Runner` type with a `RunOnce` method meant to batch-rebuild all memo payloads, but this `Runner` is never constructed or started by `server.go`/`cmd/memos`. Only the package-level `RebuildMemoPayload` function is used, and it's invoked synchronously inside request-handling code in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (on memo create/update), not as a scheduled/background job.
